package probe

import "os/exec"

// A helper whose return the check reads as an Env value proves that value only
// while it has no named results and no defer statement in its body (P5): a
// deferred closure can set a named result to nil after the return expression,
// and a panic leaves every result zero. The finding is the helper's
// declaration, and the assignment that reads it is refused as any value the
// check cannot prove is, so the run after it is refused too.

func emptiedEnv() (env []string) {
	defer func() { env = nil }()
	return []string{}
}

func recoveredEnv() []string {
	defer func() { _ = recover() }()
	return []string{}
}

func envHelperShapes() error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = emptiedEnv()
	_ = cmd.Run()

	other := exec.Command("sh")
	other.Env = recoveredEnv()
	return other.Run()
}
